role: Animal breeding: when two in-love animals of the same kind find each other they walk together, and after 60 ticks within 3 blocks a baby spawns with heart particles and an XP orb under doMobLoot.

members.name: theAnimal
members.note: folded: the task runs on the owning struct living

members.name: theWorld
members.note: folded: the native task reaches the world through the owning an_world

members.name: updateTask
members.note: look 10/verticalFaceSpeed, tryMoveToEntityLiving, ++spawnBabyDelay, spawnBaby at 60 ticks within dist^2 < 9

members.name: getNearbyMate
members.note: closest same-kind animal in the 8-block box; the native comment records canMateWith's strict class comparison (a cow never mates a mooshroom)

members.name: spawnBaby
members.note: createChild -> animal_create_child, the breeder credit (animalsBred, breedCow), both parents to age 6000, baby -24000

notes: The achievements (StatList.field_151186_x, AchievementList.field_150962_H for cows) are not part of the native tick: no player is credited because func_146083_cb (the breeder player) is not tracked. The heart particle draws are kept because they consume the parent's RNG.
